verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies page says the firm is present in key venture hubs across several countries, including the US, London, Hong Kong and Singapore. Its privacy and trademark pages describe global practice reach. Together these support one firm covering multiple countries, but the evidence does not explicitly confirm owned offices or local-law-qualified practices in each jurisdiction, so the founder's 'no second firm' outcome is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit office list or country-by-country confirmation of locally qualified practices, evidence of handling cross-border expansion matters for founders, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm

citations.quote: As the only global law firm present in all key US and global venture and growth capital hubs — from the Bay Area, Austin, and Boston to London, Hong Kong, and Singapore
delivers full-spectrum legal support around the globe
maintaining and policing trademark portfolios throughout the world
